verdict.rationale: The README shows the local server starting from the command line with `llama serve -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF`, and a built-in web UI runs against that server, so CLI start of a local model server is clearly delivered. Stopping is not explicitly documented; it is only implied because the server runs as a foreground CLI process. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of stopping or managing the server (e.g. a stop command, signal handling, daemon mode), in-depth server flag docs beyond the one-line snippet, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server workflow.
